in_sanskrit.name: Maidul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Moon God
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Maidul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Maidul is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Mahadool', which means 'Great Moon'. This name is associated with the calming and peaceful energy of the Moon, and is believed to bring tranquility and emotional balance.
